translations.web: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
translations.bsb: The Lord gives the command; a great company of women proclaim it:
translations.kjv: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published
translations.asv: The Lord giveth the word: The women that publish the tidings are a great host.
